children: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) is leaning into a premium, AI-driven growth push — rolling out foldable iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max with new A20 Pro chips, expanded Siri/Apple Intelligence, strong shipment gains and analyst upgrades, while prepping major AI infrastructure and steady pricing amid upgrade demand.
Previous Week Recap
Apple Inc. Foldable Duo Launch
: Apple (AAPL) launched the foldable iPhone Duo with a 7.6-inch display, $1,999 base price, preorders from Oct 16 and deliveries starting Oct 23 — new premium form factor in iPhone lineup
Apple Q3 Revenue, Siri Mention
: Apple (AAPL) Q3 revenue $109.4B; iPhone sales ~$54.3B. Company mentioned Siri AI within its ecosystem.
iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max Pre-orders
: Apple (AAPL) launched iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max; pre-orders Sept 12, retail Sept 18. Early delivery waits: Pro Max ~25 days, Pro ~16 days vs prior-year 19/12. Shares flat pre-market.
iPhone Shipping Boost, Share Record
: AAPL shipped ~13% more iPhones in Q2 2026, raising global smartphone share to a record 21%; iPhone 17 demand drove gains while Apple kept prices steady despite higher memory costs.
Expanded AI Siri Intelligence Gemini
: Apple (AAPL) expanded AI for Siri and Apple Intelligence, integrating Google’s Gemini into its Apple Foundation Models alongside other external providers to power device-level AI features.
Upgrade Demand For iPhone; Foldables
: About 300 million iPhone users haven’t upgraded in 4+ years, implying upgrade demand. Analysts expect foldable iPhone to reach ~15–20% of Pro/Pro Max sales and note Apple’s pricing power.
Evercore Raises Apple Target/Outperform

: Evercore ISI raised Apple (AAPL) target and kept Outperform after a large consumer survey showed stronger iPhone 18 demand, notable Pro/Pro Max interest, and increased Apple Watch and AirPods intent.
iOS 27 With Enhanced Siri
: AAPL rolled out iOS 27 on Sept 14 with upgraded Siri using personal context, broader app support, enhanced image-editing, and wider device compatibility (iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 16+).
AI Data Centers: NVIDIA, Google TPUs
: Apple (AAPL) buying large volumes of NVIDIA GPUs and Google TPUs for AI data centers; collaborating with Broadcom on in‑house AI chips.
iPhone 18 Pro With A20 Pro
: Apple (AAPL) launched iPhone 18 Pro with 2nm A20 Pro chip, wider Siri AI across 300,000+ apps, variable-aperture main camera, and battery life up to 36h (Pro) / 45h (Pro Max).
